DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS)

Based on the classic tetrad of fever, altered mentation, severe muscle rigidity (suggested by your history of tics and haloperidol use), and markedly elevated creatine kinase, you are suffering from NMS. Immediate discontinuation of haloperidol and supportive care are critical.
